import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface

prog = currentProgram
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x140652050")
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
out = {"name": str(f.getName()), "body": str(f.getBody()), "signature": str(f.getSignature())}
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(prog)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor)
    if not res.decompileCompleted():
        out["error"] = str(res.getErrorMessage())
    else:
        out["c"] = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
finally:
    d.dispose()
